problem: Live image remained available but GUI input failed and a persistent Connected/error modal obscured the screen.

findings.renderer: Wheel/move events were dispatched without backpressure; release could be skipped when display metadata was temporarily unavailable.

changes: Serialize USB iOS GUI input; coalesce pending wheel and move events; preserve release/cancel.
Do not start another gesture until the preceding release completes; stop queued writes after failure without replay.
Always release a gesture during missing geometry; cancel buffered gesture on failure or disposal.
Nonblocking bottom input error with explicit owner-scoped reconnect; recreate renderer input flow after successful reopen.

automated.electronUI: English and Chinese; failure notice does not resize canvas, explicit reconnect restores input; PNG/H264 rendering and controls passed with simulated device IPC
automated.regressions: Missing-geometry release failed before the fix; 200-event wheel/move burst and failure/cancellation cleanup covered.

physicalDevice.method: Mouse input through the production Electron GUI, not just CLI input
screenshotMode: Two eight-page wheel scrolls plus drag followed by a numeric tap; display changed from 9 to 91
replayKitMode: Two eight-page wheel scrolls followed by a numeric tap; display changed from 91 to 912

limitations: WDA transport EPIPE recurred before this verification and required restarting the dedicated Runner; the service interruption root cause remains unresolved.
Physical reconnect after an actual input failure was not injected; reconnect behavior was verified with simulated IPC and backend tests.
Long-running stability, full disconnect/reconnect matrix and arbitrary rapid input sequences remain pending.
